# The scale ticket decides your margin, not the rental price.

> Free calculator for independent roll-off dumpster rental operators: price a rental from the included weight allowance, tipping fee, labor, and mileage, then check whether your overage rate actually covers your own disposal cost before a heavy load erases the margin.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
